label: FP-WF4 — Collection of Local Data for Calibration

artifacts.artifact: SensLog data model and API-based access
artifacts.transferabilityNotes: Portable: the SensLog data model and API-based access are reusable unchanged.

artifacts.artifact: physical sensor network (local soil sensors and meteorological stations)
artifacts.transferabilityNotes: Installing new sensors is not the only way to satisfy the replacement: existing observation data also qualifies.

transferability.transferabilityNotes: The source names no region, period or class, so the envelope is empty; that does not mean the results are valid everywhere. Local sensors are assumed to be installed, maintained and correctly described by metadata, and data quality depends on sensor calibration, measurement depth, temporal coverage and gap handling. Interpretation of soil moisture differences should be adapted to local soil, rooting depth, stand structure and management context.
